core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aasma is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Name”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Aasma corresponds to the Arabic form أسماء (س م و). Its core sense is heaven, sky, celestial realm. أسماء is the plural of اسم ('name') and also relates to سمو ('elevation'). Associated with Asmāʾ bint Abī Bakr in the sīra tradition.
